newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NextLevel Systems started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NextLevel Systems started.

text.p: UBS Securities said it initiated coverage of NextLevel Systems Inc with a hold rating.

-- Said hold rating is due to NextLevel's high exposure to the TV set top converter market, which could limit the P/E multiple on the stock and pose a risk to the company's profit margins in the long-term.

-- Said may reconsider the hold rating is additional competition is the digital set top converter market does not materialize and if the company is more successful in entering the digital loop carrier market.
-- On Monday, the three new public companies, including NextLevel, that emerged from the strategic reorganization of General Instrument Corp began trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
-- NextLevel, which supplies systems and components for high-performance communications networks, gained 15/16 to 21-1/8.
